claim: On an RTX 4090, frozen-release PDG default mode achieves at least 10x pinned-PDAL wall-clock performance on r6 for at least 90% of independently sampled eligible 3DEP projects, with a one-sided exact 95% confidence bound.

selection.catalog_rule: Freeze the complete public 3DEP project catalog snapshot before selection. Eligible projects are ranked by SHA-256(seed + NUL + project_id); take the first 40. Within each project, eligible tiles are ranked by SHA-256(seed + NUL + project_id + NUL + tile_id); take the first tile.
eligibility: The catalog record identifies one distinct 3DEP project.
At least one public HTTPS LAZ or COPC tile is listed as directly downloadable without credentials.
exclusions: Catalog entries that are aliases of an already selected project, resolved from the frozen catalog before ranking.
Catalog entries with no listed public HTTPS LAZ or COPC tile.
selection.replacement_rule: No replacement after the 40-project selection is sealed. An unavailable URL, failed download, oracle decode failure, memory refusal, missing input, exactness failure, or benchmark failure remains one failed project-level outcome.
selection.independence_rule: Only one tile from each unique 3DEP project contributes one Bernoulli outcome. Repeats and additional tiles do not increase n.

pipeline.description: readers.las -> filters.normal(knn=8) -> filters.covariancefeatures(knn=8, Dimensionality) -> compressed writers.las

artifacts.candidate: Exact user-downloadable PDG release payload, closed by pdg-frozen-release-artifact-v1 before timing.
artifacts.oracle: Independently built pinned PDAL oracle included in the same closed payload.
artifacts.mutation_policy: No configure, build, install, profile conversion, or payload write after closure. Verify the complete payload before and after the study.

machine.power_and_clock_policy: unchanged during the study and reported

timing.scope: whole process including read, compute, and write
timing.order: alternating oracle/candidate order as implemented by benchmark_reference.py
timing.summary: median wall-clock seconds for each executable; oracle median divided by candidate median

correctness.requirement: Every timed candidate output, stdout, stderr, and exit status must satisfy the pinned-oracle exact contract. An inexact attempt is a failure and produces no accepted performance result.

endpoint.success: return code zero AND exact_outputs true AND median_speedup >= 10.0
endpoint.minimum_all-success_result: 29/29; the planned 40/40 result has lower bound approximately 0.9278

publish: ranked selection audit including pre-timing exclusions
selected input URLs, byte sizes, point counts, and SHA-256 values
frozen artifact manifest and pre/post validation
machine, driver, CUDA, CPU, RAM, affinity, power and clock state
all warm-up and measured raw timings
analysis JSON with the exact confidence bound
reporting.third_party_status: Author-run evidence is not independent third-party validation. No external validation is claimed by this protocol.
